title: Creative Review SLA
description: Time from seller receipt of a creative review submission to an approved or rejected decision for a format the product accepts. Ingestion, processing, pending_review, and suspended are not terminal decisions. Applies to each accepted review submission independently. Idempotent replay does not restart the clock; changed content requiring review starts a new clock. Absence means no review commitment. Elapsed time includes non-working time (P1D = PT24H). Business time uses the referenced calendar's working periods and business_day_minutes for P1D. Compare clocks using deadlines for the same receipt time. Only creative review carries a business clock; other SLA windows are elapsed time.

clock.description: Business time starts at seller receipt, advancing to the next working period when outside working time.

business_calendar_id.description: Immutable seller-local ID in get_adcp_capabilities.business_calendars; required only for business time.

response_max.description: ISO 8601 bound from seller receipt of the review submission to the seller acknowledging it for review.

completion_max.description: ISO 8601 bound from seller receipt of the review submission to an approved or rejected decision.

verifier_constraints.calendar_reference: A business_calendar_id resolves to exactly one immutable get_adcp_capabilities.business_calendars declaration whose coverage includes receipt and the computed deadline. Invalid or unresolved calendars never fall back to elapsed time.
verifier_constraints.request_snapshot: Pending reviews retain the SLA and calendar resolved at receipt. Maxima are independent upper bounds; a completion maximum shorter than the response maximum does not invalidate either commitment.
